tests.description: Reference: WRF 4.8 em_scm_xy single-column run (GNU real32 build, dt = 60 s, 59 layers, mp=6 ra_lw=1 ra_sw=1 sf_sfclay=1 sf_surface=1 bl_pbl=1, radt = 30 min) dumped by the instrumented fork ctessum-claude/WRF (module_esm_dump hooks inside SUBROUTINE RRTM after GASABS and inside RTRN of phys/module_ra_rrtm.F; dump scm_ref2_1.json). RRTM has no standalone real64 driver, so every expected value is the real32 in-model value and the tolerance contract is rel 1e-5. Inputs are the dumped extended-column state (TAVEL, TZ, PZ, CLDFRAC, TAUCLOUD, SEMISS, TBOUND) and the GASABS outputs PFRAC and ITR (140 g-points x 103 layers, injected as flattened columns); the gas optics themselves are not transcribed. Expected values: the RTRN fluxes TOTUFLUX/TOTDFLUX and clear-sky TOTUCLFL/TOTDCLFL at every RRTM level, the per-band fluxes at the surface, model top and top of the column, the Planck integrals PLANKBND/PLVL/PLAY, and the heating rates HTR/HTRC (K/day). The scheme is diagnostic (no time step). Regime: call 1, 19:00 UTC (12:34 LST), first radiation call; clear sky (no cloudy layer); tbound = 288.00 K, glw = 258.1 W/m^2, olr (model top) = 251.5 W/m^2, TOA upward flux 244.8 W/m^2. Tolerances: measured against a NumPy replica of RTRN the component's fluxes agree with the real32 dump to <= 1e-6 relative (2e-4 W/m^2), the band fluxes to 2e-5 W/m^2, the Planck integrals to 2e-10, and the heating rates to 4e-4 K/day (HTR is a difference of O(300 W/m^2) fluxes over O(6 hPa) layers carried in single precision, so its relative error is ~1e-4 of the column maximum); tolerances are set 3-5x above those floors: fluxes rel 1e-5 spot / Linf abs 1e-3 W/m^2, band fluxes Linf abs 1e-4, Planck Linf abs 1e-9, HTR/HTRC Linf abs 2e-3 K/day and spot checks rel 1e-4 at the three largest-|HTR| layers.

Reference: WRF 4.8 em_scm_xy single-column run (GNU real32 build, dt = 60 s, 59 layers, mp=6 ra_lw=1 ra_sw=1 sf_sfclay=1 sf_surface=1 bl_pbl=1, radt = 30 min) dumped by the instrumented fork ctessum-claude/WRF (module_esm_dump hooks inside SUBROUTINE RRTM after GASABS and inside RTRN of phys/module_ra_rrtm.F; dump scm_ref2_120.json). RRTM has no standalone real64 driver, so every expected value is the real32 in-model value and the tolerance contract is rel 1e-5. Inputs are the dumped extended-column state (TAVEL, TZ, PZ, CLDFRAC, TAUCLOUD, SEMISS, TBOUND) and the GASABS outputs PFRAC and ITR (140 g-points x 103 layers, injected as flattened columns); the gas optics themselves are not transcribed. Expected values: the RTRN fluxes TOTUFLUX/TOTDFLUX and clear-sky TOTUCLFL/TOTDCLFL at every RRTM level, the per-band fluxes at the surface, model top and top of the column, the Planck integrals PLANKBND/PLVL/PLAY, and the heating rates HTR/HTRC (K/day). The scheme is diagnostic (no time step). Regime: OVERCAST, optically thick. Call 120, 20:00 UTC (13:34 LST), the deepest cirrus deck of the run: RRTM layers 51-57 all have CLDFRAC = 1 with TAUCLOUD 0.054, 0.636, 0.760, 0.467, 0.233, 0.084, 0.024, so the cloud absorptance ABSCLD = 1 - exp(-1.66 TAUCLOUD) reaches 0.72 and EFCLFRAC = ABSCLD (CLDFRAC = 1); this is the regime in which the cloudy branch of the RTRN sweeps (loops 2000/4000, the Pade-weighted total source BBUTOT/BBDLEVD and the combined absorptance ATOT) dominates the transfer. tbound = 285.69 K, glw = 292.8 W/m^2 against a clear-sky 260.9 W/m^2 (a 31.9 W/m^2 surface cloud forcing), olr (model top) = 129.7 W/m^2, TOA upward flux 126.6 W/m^2, and HTR - HTRC reaches 25.0 K/day at layer 52. Tolerances: measured against the real32 dump the component's flux columns agree to Linf 1.3e-4 (F_dn), 2.0e-4 (F_up), 1.0e-4 (F_dn_clr) and 1.8e-4 W/m^2 (F_up_clr) on fluxes up to 371 W/m^2 (3e-7 relative at the spot levels), the band fluxes to 1.2e-5 W/m^2, the Planck integrals to 8.3e-11, and HTR/HTRC to 3.7e-4 / 4.3e-4 K/day on a column maximum of 23.4 K/day (3.3e-6 relative at the three cloud layers spot-checked). Tolerances are set 4-30x above those floors and are the same contract as the other RTRN regimes: fluxes rel 1e-5 spot / Linf abs 1e-3 W/m^2, band fluxes Linf abs 1e-4, Planck Linf abs 1e-9, HTR/HTRC Linf abs 2e-3 K/day and spot checks rel 1e-4 at the three cloudy layers 52, 54 and 55 (the three largest |HTR| of the column).

Reference: WRF 4.8 em_scm_xy single-column run (GNU real32 build, dt = 60 s, 59 layers, mp=6 ra_lw=1 ra_sw=1 sf_sfclay=1 sf_surface=1 bl_pbl=1, radt = 30 min) dumped by the instrumented fork ctessum-claude/WRF (module_esm_dump hooks inside SUBROUTINE RRTM after GASABS and inside RTRN of phys/module_ra_rrtm.F; dump scm_cloud_240.json, written by the same em_scm_xy run re-executed for 8 h with the cloudy calls added to ESM_DUMP_CALLS; the re-run reproduces the archived call 120 dump bit-for-bit, so it is the same trajectory). RRTM has no standalone real64 driver, so every expected value is the real32 in-model value and the tolerance contract is rel 1e-5. Inputs are the dumped extended-column state (TAVEL, TZ, PZ, CLDFRAC, TAUCLOUD, SEMISS, TBOUND) and the GASABS outputs PFRAC and ITR (140 g-points x 103 layers, injected as flattened columns); the gas optics themselves are not transcribed. Expected values: the RTRN fluxes TOTUFLUX/TOTDFLUX and clear-sky TOTUCLFL/TOTDCLFL at every RRTM level, the per-band fluxes at the surface, model top and top of the column, the Planck integrals PLANKBND/PLVL/PLAY, and the heating rates HTR/HTRC (K/day). The scheme is diagnostic (no time step). Regime: FRACTIONAL CLOUD. Call 240, 21:00 UTC (14:34 LST), the decaying cirrus deck: RRTM layer 55 has CLDFRAC = 0.1470 with TAUCLOUD = 0.009966, so ABSCLD = 0.016407 but EFCLFRAC = ABSCLD CLDFRAC = 0.002412 - the only place in the RTRN sweeps where the cloud fraction is not 1 and the two coefficients differ (here by a factor 6.8). MM5ATM forces CLDFRC = 1 wherever TAUCLOUD > 0.01 (phys/module_ra_rrtm.F:4254), so a layer can only reach RTRN with 0 < CLDFRAC < 1 when its cloud optical depth is at or below 0.01: this layer sits exactly at that ceiling and is therefore the strongest fractional-cloud case the scheme admits. Layers 51-54, 56 and 57 are overcast (TAUCLOUD 0.0728, 0.1423, 0.0709, 0.0403, 0.00475, 0.00296), so the column also exercises fractional and overcast cloudy layers stacked in one sweep. tbound = 285.85 K, glw = 276.6 W/m^2 against a clear-sky 262.8 W/m^2, olr (model top) = 207.4 W/m^2, TOA upward flux 201.7 W/m^2, HTR - HTRC = 2.27 K/day at layer 51 and 0.131 K/day (8.7 % of HTR) in the fractional layer 55. Tolerances: measured against the real32 dump the component's flux columns agree to Linf 1.4e-4 (F_dn), 1.5e-4 (F_up), 1.0e-4 (F_dn_clr) and 2.5e-4 W/m^2 (F_up_clr) on fluxes up to 370 W/m^2 (5e-8 to 5e-7 relative at the spot levels), the band fluxes to 1.1e-5 W/m^2, the Planck integrals to 2.2e-10, and HTR/HTRC to 2.5e-4 / 3.5e-4 K/day. The spot-checked heating rates are small (|HTR| = 1.03, 0.57 and 1.51 K/day at layers 51, 52 and the fractional layer 55), so the same 2.5e-4 K/day floor is 7.3e-5 relative at layer 51; the HTR spot tolerance is therefore rel 2e-4 here instead of the 1e-4 used where |HTR| is large. Everything else is the standard RTRN contract, 4-8x above the measured floors: fluxes rel 1e-5 spot / Linf abs 1e-3 W/m^2, band fluxes Linf abs 1e-4, Planck Linf abs 1e-9, HTR/HTRC Linf abs 2e-3 K/day.

Reference: WRF 4.8 em_scm_xy single-column run (GNU real32 build, dt = 60 s, 59 layers, mp=6 ra_lw=1 ra_sw=1 sf_sfclay=1 sf_surface=1 bl_pbl=1, radt = 30 min) dumped by the instrumented fork ctessum-claude/WRF (module_esm_dump hooks inside SUBROUTINE RRTM after GASABS and inside RTRN of phys/module_ra_rrtm.F; dump scm_cloud_648.json, written by the same em_scm_xy run re-executed for 8 h with the cloudy calls added to ESM_DUMP_CALLS; the re-run reproduces the archived call 120 dump bit-for-bit, so it is the same trajectory). RRTM has no standalone real64 driver, so every expected value is the real32 in-model value and the tolerance contract is rel 1e-5. Inputs are the dumped extended-column state (TAVEL, TZ, PZ, CLDFRAC, TAUCLOUD, SEMISS, TBOUND) and the GASABS outputs PFRAC and ITR (140 g-points x 103 layers, injected as flattened columns); the gas optics themselves are not transcribed. Expected values: the RTRN fluxes TOTUFLUX/TOTDFLUX and clear-sky TOTUCLFL/TOTDCLFL at every RRTM level, the per-band fluxes at the surface, model top and top of the column, the Planck integrals PLANKBND/PLVL/PLAY, and the heating rates HTR/HTRC (K/day). The scheme is diagnostic (no time step). Regime: MULTI-LAYER OVERLAP. Call 648, 00:24 UTC (17:58 LST), thin residual cirrus: three adjacent fractional layers (53: CLDFRAC = 0.0698, TAUCLOUD = 0.00983; 54: 0.0194, 0.00160; 55: 0.0387, 0.00152) sandwiched between overcast layers (52: TAUCLOUD = 0.0237; 56: 0.00138; 57: 0.000387; 59: 6.5e-8), plus a layer with condensate but CLDFRAC = 0 (51, TAUCLOUD = 0.00314, which RTRN treats as clear because ICLDLYR = 0 when CLDFRAC = 0). The sweep therefore passes through clear, fractional and overcast layers in both directions and accumulates the clear-sky radiance from the first cloudy layer downward (ICLDDN, note N31). tbound = 281.17 K, glw = 262.7 W/m^2 against a clear-sky 261.4 W/m^2, olr (model top) = 242.4 W/m^2, TOA upward flux 235.5 W/m^2, HTR - HTRC = 0.099 K/day at layer 51 and 0.015 K/day in the fractional layer 53. Tolerances: measured against the real32 dump the component's flux columns agree to Linf 1.0e-4 (F_dn), 1.6e-4 (F_up), 8.9e-5 (F_dn_clr) and 1.9e-4 W/m^2 (F_up_clr) on fluxes up to 347 W/m^2 (4e-7 relative at the spot levels), the band fluxes to 1.5e-5 W/m^2, the Planck integrals to 1.1e-10, and HTR/HTRC to 2.8e-4 / 2.7e-4 K/day. As at call 240 the spot-checked heating rates are of order 1.3-1.8 K/day, so the flux noise is 5.3e-5 relative at layer 51 and the HTR spot tolerance is rel 2e-4. Everything else is the standard RTRN contract, 4-10x above the measured floors: fluxes rel 1e-5 spot / Linf abs 1e-3 W/m^2, band fluxes Linf abs 1e-4, Planck Linf abs 1e-9, HTR/HTRC Linf abs 2e-3 K/day.

Reference: WRF 4.8 idealized supercell (em_quarter_ss, Weisman-Klemp sounding, 41 x 41 x 59 mass points, dx = 2 km, dt = 6 s, ztop = 12800 m so p_top = 177.07 hPa and NBUF = 44, i.e. the same 59 + 44 = 103-layer RRTM column as the em_scm_xy regimes) with mp=6 (WSM6), ra_lw=1, ra_sw=1, radt = 5 min, GNU real32 build, dumped by the instrumented fork ctessum-claude/WRF (module_esm_dump hooks inside SUBROUTINE RRTM after GASABS and inside RTRN of phys/module_ra_rrtm.F; dump qss_i20_268.json, call 268 = j-row 22 of radiation call 7, column i = 20 selected with the new ESM_DUMP_I). RRTM has no standalone real64 driver, so every expected value is the real32 in-model value and the tolerance contract is rel 1e-5. Inputs are the dumped extended-column state (TAVEL, TZ, PZ, CLDFRAC, TAUCLOUD, SEMISS, TBOUND) and the GASABS outputs PFRAC and ITR (140 g-points x 103 layers, injected as flattened columns); the gas optics themselves are not transcribed. Expected values: the RTRN fluxes TOTUFLUX/TOTDFLUX and clear-sky TOTUCLFL/TOTDCLFL at every RRTM level, the per-band fluxes at the surface, model top and top of the column, the Planck integrals PLANKBND/PLVL/PLAY, and the heating rates HTR/HTRC (K/day). The scheme is diagnostic (no time step). Regime: OPAQUE MIXED-PHASE STORM COLUMN -- the saturated limit of the cloudy branch, which the em_scm_xy regimes never reach. Model time 00:30:00 in a mature supercell: 46 of the 59 model layers are overcast (CLDFRAC = 1) and TAUCLOUD runs to 18.74, so ABSCLD = 1 - exp(-1.66 TAUCLOUD) is 1 to within 3e-14 in 25 of them, against a maximum of 0.72 anywhere in the SCM run; exactly one layer (RRTM layer 56, TAUCLOUD = 4.81e-3, below MM5ATM's 0.01 override threshold, N58) keeps a fractional CLDFRAC = 0.010691. tbound = 300.02 K. glw = 451.10 W/m^2 against a clear-sky 405.73 (a 45.4 W/m^2 surface cloud forcing), olr (model top) = 160.52 W/m^2 against a clear-sky 259.46 (the opaque cloud removes 98.9 W/m^2 of outgoing longwave), TOA upward flux 159.30 W/m^2, and HTR - HTRC reaches 41.0 K/day at layer 40, at the ice/liquid cloud top -- 1.6x the largest cloud-radiative heating anywhere in the SCM regimes. Tolerances: measured against the real32 dump the component's flux columns agree to Linf 1.8e-4 (F_dn), 1.5e-4 (F_up), 2.2e-4 (F_dn_clr) and 2.0e-4 W/m^2 (F_up_clr) on fluxes up to 458 W/m^2 (<= 4.0e-7 relative at the spot levels), the band fluxes to 1.2e-5 W/m^2, the Planck integrals to 2.0e-10, and HTR/HTRC to 2.0e-4 / 2.6e-4 K/day on a column maximum of 43.5 K/day (<= 2.1e-6 relative at the three cloud-top layers spot-checked). Tolerances are set 5-50x above those floors and are the same contract as the other RTRN regimes: fluxes rel 1e-5 spot / Linf abs 1e-3 W/m^2, band fluxes Linf abs 1e-4, Planck Linf abs 1e-9, HTR/HTRC Linf abs 2e-3 K/day and spot checks rel 1e-4 at layers 39, 40 and 41, the three largest |HTR| of the column.
